mapper.select: INSERT INTO purchase_orders (order_number, store_id, supplier_id, status, total_amount, ordered_at, created_by) VALUES (#{orderNumber}, #{storeId}, #{supplierId}, 'DRAFT', #{totalAmount}, #{orderedAt}, #{createdBy}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO purchase_order_items (purchase_order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price) VALUES
(#{purchaseOrderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.totalPrice})
mapper.select:
SELECT po.id, po.order_number, po.ordered_at, po.store_id, st.store_name, po.supplier_id, sp.supplier_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_order_items poi WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = po.id) AS item_count, po.total_amount, po.status FROM purchase_orders po JOIN stores st ON st.id = po.store_id JOIN suppliers sp ON sp.id = po.supplier_id
ORDER BY po.ordered_at DESC, po.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT po.id, po.order_number, po.store_id, st.store_name, po.supplier_id, sp.supplier_name, po.status, po.total_amount, po.ordered_at, cu.name AS created_by_name, po.approved_at, au.name AS approved_by_name, po.completed_at, ru.name AS completed_by_name, po.cancelled_at, xu.name AS cancelled_by_name, po.updated_at, uu.name AS updated_by_name FROM purchase_orders po JOIN stores st ON st.id = po.store_id JOIN suppliers sp ON sp.id = po.supplier_id JOIN users cu ON cu.id = po.created_by LEFT JOIN users au ON au.id = po.approved_by LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = po.completed_by LEFT JOIN users xu ON xu.id = po.cancelled_by LEFT JOIN users uu ON uu.id = po.updated_by WHERE po.id = #{id}

SELECT poi.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, poi.quantity, poi.unit_price, poi.total_price FROM purchase_order_items poi JOIN products p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY poi.id
SELECT id, store_id, status FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
